Esq. Aquiles Serdán y Golfo Tehuantepec, Claveria

Friendly pulqueria offering natural and curada pulques at prices as low as M$45 per litre. The oat (avena) and nut (nuez) flavored pulques are popular, or you can be bold and order a campechano, which is half sweet and half sour.
